title: EventBus callback remove other listener by equivalent bound-callback recovery contract

contract.cross_callback_unregister_isolation: A callback can remove another registered listener during EventBus.emit() without aborting the active broadcast
contract.equivalent_bound_callback_resolution: Unregister resolves an equivalent bound-method callback to the registered listener
contract.current_cycle_delivery_continuity: The listener removed during an active callback still receives the current broadcast exactly once
contract.post_remove_isolation: A listener removed during a callback receives no subsequent broadcasts
contract.remaining_listener_continuity: Other registered listeners continue receiving broadcasts after cross-callback removal
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after callback-driven cross-listener removal
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Cross-callback removal does not create duplicate owner entries
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after callback-driven cross-listener removal
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
